verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair axis for a SaaS product with a public API, so the story applies. However, the probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown doc variants (404) and no OpenAPI file at the docs host. The Graph CSDL $metadata document is a machine-readable API schema, not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit here.
